title: Two saloons started a price war

lines.tts: [storytelling] Two saloons started a price war. A third one won... without cutting a single price.
lines.text: Two saloons started a price war. A third one won... without cutting a single price.

lines.tts: [dry] By Friday, lemonade was free... and both saloons were broke.
lines.text: By Friday, lemonade was free... and both saloons were broke.

lines.tts: [intrigued] Then Rosa opened across the street. Her lemonade? Ten cents.
lines.text: Then Rosa opened across the street. Her lemonade? Ten cents.

lines.tts: [triumphant] Everyone. Rosa's had shade, a piano... and ice-cold lemonade.
lines.text: Everyone. Rosa's had shade, a piano... and ice-cold lemonade.

lines.tts: Compete on price, and you race to zero. Compete on what makes you different.
lines.text: Compete on price, and you race to zero. Compete on what makes you different.
